justification: S1 fail-closed mechanism + the highest-severity self-contained fix, from the adversarial key-contract audit (2026-06-22). The dangerous class is `_df.value or {default}` discarding a DataField's NOT_AVAILABLE signal -> a FAILED fetch re-stamped as a confident AUTHORITATIVE negative. Added _unwrap_or_default(df, default)->(value, failed) as the sanctioned replacement that preserves the failure signal. Fixed STRATA (the worst case): a failed strata lookup was served as authoritative 'not strata' AND silently routed a possible apartment into a full DevelopmentBrief; now a failed strata is AMBIGUOUS (renovation path, no dev-capacity claims) with a NOT_AVAILABLE card. Added scripts/lint_brief_failsoft.py (blocks new un-annotated `_df.value or <container/computed default>`; allows `# failsoft-ok` verified-safe and `# failsoft-todo` tracked) and wired it into pre-commit. Annotated the 4 remaining sites: valuation/sepp/nearby-DA = failsoft-ok (verified-safe / #582-guarded); controls (WO-3) + overlays (WO-2) = failsoft-todo (tracked for their own PRs with build-function changes + live verify). 8 new tests.

pre_impl.existing_data: DataField docstring already encodes 3-state semantics (value+conf=present; None+conf!=NA=genuine empty; None+conf=NA=failed). The bug is purely the `.value or {default}` sites discarding df.confidence. classify_strata already has an AMBIGUOUS state -> renovation routing.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A blanket DataField validator forbidding AUTHORITATIVE+null is WRONG (legit 'checked, genuinely none' uses it). The failure signal lives in the SOURCE df.confidence, discarded by `or {default}`. So the fix is a helper that preserves it + per-site handling, not a validator.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused the existing AMBIGUOUS->renovation routing and the #582 da_failed guard pattern; added one helper + one lint (no existing lint covers this).
pre_impl.external_source_error: A failed strata/overlay/controls fetch now surfaces as NOT_AVAILABLE; strata routing degrades to the conservative renovation path (no false dev-capacity claims).
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend (helper + strata) + a lint script + a pre-commit hook line. 167 brief tests pass.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a failed strata fetch -> confident 'not strata' + a DevelopmentBrief for a possible apartment. After: NOT_AVAILABLE strata card + renovation routing. New silent-false-negatives are blocked at commit by the lint.

functions.name: _unwrap_or_default
functions.input: a DataField and a default value
functions.output: a tuple of (value-or-default, failed) where failed is True only when the upstream fetch did not succeed (confidence == NOT_AVAILABLE)
functions.if_none: a genuine empty (value None but confidence not NOT_AVAILABLE) returns failed=False, so legitimate 'checked, none here' is not mistaken for a failure

functions.name: scan
functions.input: a path to a python source file to scan
functions.output: blocking errors for un-annotated `_df.value or <container/computed default>` and tracked warnings for failsoft-todo annotations
functions.if_none: a file with no matches returns no errors and the lint passes

values: N/A - control-flow + confidence, not regulatory values.

break_it.scenario: A strata fetch genuinely succeeds and finds the lot is not strata
break_it.what_happens: must stay AUTHORITATIVE 'not strata' + development routing, not be forced to renovation
break_it.how: strata_failed is only True when confidence == NOT_AVAILABLE; a successful not-strata result keeps classify_strata -> NOT_STRATA -> development. Guarded by test_genuine_empty_is_not_a_failure

break_it.scenario: The lint mis-flags a harmless scalar default like `or None`
break_it.what_happens: a false positive blocking a safe line
break_it.how: the pattern only matches container `{`/`[` or computed `func(` defaults, not scalars. Guarded by test_lint_allows_scalar_default

break_it.scenario: A new `_df.value or {default}` is added without handling the failure
break_it.what_happens: a new silent false-negative could ship
break_it.how: the pre-commit failsoft lint blocks it; the developer must use _unwrap_or_default or annotate. Guarded by test_lint_blocks_unannotated_anti_pattern + test_lint_blocks_computed_default

break_it.scenario: A transient strata-fetch failure routes a house to renovation, losing dev cards
break_it.what_happens: a house briefly shows a renovation brief on a failed strata run
break_it.repro: strata_df times out for a house
break_it.how: strata fetch is fast/reliable (~0.2s) so failures are rare; renovation (no false dev claims) is the conservative trade-off vs serving a misleading DevelopmentBrief for a possible apartment

post_merge.manual_verify: Run the brief for the Hurstville strata address (5/1 Treacy St) — strata card populates; simulate a strata-fetch failure -> strata card NOT_AVAILABLE + renovation routing, not a confident DevelopmentBrief. The pre-commit lint blocks any new un-annotated `_df.value or {default}`.
